[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

[[Category:Cherry Fork Cemetery, Cherry Fork, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
Eliza was born in 1818. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-193|James Glasgow]] and [[McNeil-3468|Mary McNeil]]. She passed away in 1909.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-193]] is assessed at 90% (proved). Faris’s 1990 Glasgow Family genealogy p.78 supports Eliza Jane (Glasgow) McNeil as a child of James Glasgow and Mary McNeil. The 23 October 1818 birth follows their 20 November 1817 Adams County marriage and fits the documented local family.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Trace Faris’s child entry to its original marriage/probate evidence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2174 SOURCE: Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p. 78]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
